safety: Sitting back toward the heels keeps the movement in the upper back.
aliases: Hand-behind-head T-spine rotation; Quadruped T-spine rotation

name: Quadruped wrist rocks
form_cues: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.; Rock forward and back over the hands, keeping palms flat.; Repeat with fingers turned out, then with backs of hands down.
common_mistakes: Letting palms peel off the floor; Pushing into sharp pain
safety: Shift less body weight onto the hands if wrists are sensitive.
aliases: Wrist prep rocks; All-fours wrist rocks
notes: Great before handstands, push-ups and front squats.

name: Scorpion stretch
form_cues: Lie face down with arms out wide.; Lift one leg and reach the foot toward the opposite hand.; Keep both shoulders as close to the floor as you can.
common_mistakes: Shoulders lifting off the floor; Swinging the leg fast
safety: Move slowly; skip if you have a disc problem or lower back pain.

name: Shoulder CARs
form_cues: Make a tight fist and brace your whole body.; Raise the arm forward and overhead as far as possible.; Rotate the thumb out and draw the biggest slow circle behind you.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back or twisting to cheat range; Moving too fast
safety: Keep everything but the working arm still; skip painful arcs.

name: Spiderman lunge
form_cues: From a push-up position, step one foot outside the same hand.; Sink the hips and reach that elbow toward the instep.; Step back and switch sides.
common_mistakes: Hips piking up high; Front heel lifting off the floor
safety: Keep the back leg long and core braced; stop if the groin pinches.
aliases: Elbow-to-instep lunge; Lunge with elbow drop

name: Spinal CARs
form_cues: Stand tall with knees soft and squeeze your glutes lightly.; Curl down one vertebra at a time, starting at the neck.; Roll back up one segment at a time, then try side bends and rotation.
common_mistakes: Bending only at the hips; Rushing so the spine moves as one block
safety: Go slowly and avoid if you have an acute disc injury.

name: Standing hip circles
form_cues: Stand with hands on hips and feet shoulder-width.; Draw big circles with your hips.; Keep your head and shoulders still.
common_mistakes: Moving the whole upper body; Making tiny, rushed circles
safety: Keep the movement pain-free and controlled.

name: Walking hip opener and closer
form_cues: Lift one knee high in front of you.; Rotate it out to the side and down (open), or side to front (close).; Stand tall and walk forward between reps.
common_mistakes: Leaning the torso to fake range; Rushing the circle
safety: Hold a wall for balance if needed; keep the movement smooth.
aliases: Open the gate; Close the gate; Hip gate swings

name: Walking knee hug
form_cues: Step forward and pull one knee to your chest.; Rise onto the toes of the standing foot.; Release and step through to the other side.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back to meet the knee; Losing balance from rushing
safety: Hold a wall if balance is shaky.

name: Walking lunge with twist
form_cues: Step forward into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.; Rotate your chest toward the front leg.; Return to centre, then step through to the next lunge.
common_mistakes: Front knee caving inward; Twisting from the knee instead of the torso
safety: Keep steps short if knees are sore; rotate from the ribs, not the knee.
notes: Hold a light plate or ball at the chest to add load.

name: Walking quad pull
form_cues: Step forward and grab the opposite ankle behind you.; Pull heel to glute and squeeze that glute.; Reach the free arm overhead for balance.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back; Knee drifting out to the side
safety: Keep knees close together and avoid yanking the ankle.

name: Wall angel
form_cues: Stand with head, upper back and glutes against a wall.; Hold arms in a W with backs of hands on the wall.; Slide arms up and down without anything lifting away.
common_mistakes: Lower back arching off the wall; Hands peeling away from the wall
safety: Step feet farther out if you can't keep your back flat.

name: Wall slide
form_cues: Put forearms on a wall at shoulder height.; Slide them up, letting shoulder blades wrap around the ribs.; Lower slowly back down.
common_mistakes: Shrugging as the arms rise; Arching the lower back
progressions: Wall slide with band; Foam roller wall slide
safety: Stay below any pinching point in the shoulder.
notes: Add a loop band around the wrists for more rotator cuff work.

name: World's greatest stretch
form_cues: Step into a long lunge and put both hands inside the front foot.; Drop the inside elbow toward the instep, then rotate that arm to the ceiling.; Finish by straightening the front leg to stretch the hamstring.
common_mistakes: Letting the back knee collapse to the floor; Rushing through each position; Rotating from the lower back instead of the upper back
regressions: Spiderman lunge; Kneeling hip flexor stretch
safety: Move slowly; drop the back knee to the floor if balance is an issue.
aliases: Lunge with rotation and reach; WGS
notes: One of the best single warm-up drills: hips, hamstrings and upper back in one move.

name: Wrist circles
form_cues: Interlock fingers or make loose fists.; Draw slow, full circles with the wrists.; Keep the forearms still.
common_mistakes: Moving the elbows instead of the wrists; Going too fast
safety: Keep it pain-free; useful before push-ups, handstands and pressing.

name: Band shoulder dislocate
form_cues: Hold a band wide with straight arms in front.; Lift it overhead and behind you in one smooth arc.; Bring it back the same way.
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows; Arching the lower back
safety: Start with a wide grip and narrow it gradually.
notes: A PVC pipe or broomstick works too.

name: Banded ankle distraction
form_cues: Loop a band around the front of the ankle, anchored behind you.; Step forward into a half-kneel.; Drive the knee forward over the toes; the band pulls the ankle back.
common_mistakes: Band on the foot, not the ankle crease; Heel lifting
safety: Avoid after a recent sprain without clearance.

name: Banded hip distraction
form_cues: Loop a heavy band around the top of your thigh from a low anchor.; Step away into a kneeling lunge or all-fours position.; Rock gently into the stretch.
common_mistakes: Band sliding down to the knee; Not enough tension
safety: Anchor must be solid; band high in the hip crease.
aliases: Band hip flexor distraction; Banded hip mobilization

name: Terminal knee extension
form_cues: Loop a band behind your knee from an anchor in front.; Start with the knee slightly bent.; Squeeze the quad to straighten the knee fully.
common_mistakes: Leaning the torso forward; Letting the knee snap back
safety: Keep it pain-free; common after knee surgery.

name: 90/90 hip stretch
form_cues: Sit in the 90/90 position with both knees at right angles.; Sit tall and hinge your chest over the front shin.; Breathe slowly and relax into it.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back instead of hinging; Forcing the knee down
safety: Prop the hip on a cushion if the knee feels strained.

name: Bent-knee soleus stretch
form_cues: Stand in a short split stance facing a wall.; Bend both knees and sink the back knee toward the floor.; Keep the back heel down.
common_mistakes: Heel lifting; Standing too far from the wall
safety: Back off if the Achilles feels sharp rather than stretched.

name: Bretzel stretch
form_cues: Lie on your side, top knee bent at hip height and pinned down.; Grab the bottom foot behind you with your top hand.; Rotate your chest and shoulders toward the floor behind you.
common_mistakes: Letting the top knee lift; Holding the breath
safety: Use a strap on the back foot if you can't reach it.

name: Butterfly stretch
form_cues: Sit with the soles of your feet together.; Hold your feet and sit tall.; Let the knees drop; hinge forward a little for more.
common_mistakes: Bouncing the knees; Rounding the back
safety: Don't push the knees down with force.
aliases: Seated groin stretch; Seated adductor stretch

name: Couch stretch
equipment: Wall or couch; Mat or cushion
form_cues: Kneel with your back shin up a wall or couch.; Step the other foot forward and squeeze the back glute.; Lift your chest slowly toward upright.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back; Kneeling right on the kneecap without padding
safety: Pad the knee well and back off if the knee hurts.
aliases: Rear-foot elevated hip flexor stretch; Wall quad stretch

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
form_cues: Bring one straight arm across your chest.; Pull it in at the upper arm with the other hand.; Keep the shoulder down, away from the ear.
common_mistakes: Pulling at the elbow joint; Rotating the torso
safety: Pull above the elbow, not on the joint.

name: Doorframe lat stretch
form_cues: Grab a doorframe at hip height with one hand.; Sit your hips back and away, letting the side body lengthen.; Rotate slightly to find the tightest spot.
common_mistakes: Rounding through the shoulders only; Holding the breath
safety: Make sure the post you hold is solid.
aliases: Standing lat stretch; Door lat hang stretch

name: Doorway chest stretch
form_cues: Place your forearm on a doorframe with elbow at shoulder height.; Step through with the same-side leg.; Turn your chest slightly away until you feel the chest open.
common_mistakes: Shrugging the shoulder up; Elbow far above the shoulder
safety: Keep the elbow at or below shoulder height to protect the shoulder joint.
notes: Raise the elbow higher to bias the lower pec.

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
form_cues: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.; Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the back glute.; Shift your weight forward until you feel the front of the hip.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back; Lunging far without tucking the pelvis
safety: Pad the knee; you should feel it in the hip, not the lower back.
aliases: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch; Lunge stretch
notes: Reach the same-side arm overhead for a stronger stretch.

name: Kneeling shin stretch
form_cues: Kneel with the tops of your feet flat on the floor.; Sit back toward your heels.; Lift the knees slightly for more stretch.
common_mistakes: Sitting back on painful knees; Toes curling under
safety: Use a cushion under the knees; skip if kneeling hurts.
notes: Useful for shin splints.

name: Levator scapulae stretch
form_cues: Turn your nose toward your armpit.; Gently pull your head down with the same-side hand.; Hold the opposite shoulder down.
common_mistakes: Pulling too hard; Rounding the whole upper back
safety: Keep pressure gentle; neck stretches should never feel sharp.

name: Overhead triceps stretch
form_cues: Raise one arm and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.; Use the other hand to ease the elbow back.; Keep your ribs down.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back; Pulling the head forward
safety: Ease off if you feel pinching at the top of the shoulder.

name: PNF adductor stretch
form_cues: Sit in a butterfly with hands on the inner knees.; Press knees up into your hands for 6 seconds.; Relax and let the knees fall a little lower.
common_mistakes: Forcing the knees down; Holding the breath
safety: Gentle hand pressure only; never push through groin pain.

name: PNF chest stretch
form_cues: Set up in the doorway chest stretch.; Press the forearm into the frame for 6 seconds.; Relax, step through a little deeper and hold.
common_mistakes: Shrugging during the push; Going deeper too fast
safety: Keep the elbow at or below shoulder height.

name: PNF hamstring stretch
form_cues: Lie down with one leg raised; a partner or strap holds it at a stretch.; Push the leg down into resistance for 6 seconds.; Relax, breathe out and ease the leg higher; repeat.
common_mistakes: Pushing at full force; Partner forcing the leg past comfort
safety: Contract at moderate effort; communicate clearly with your partner.
aliases: Contract-relax hamstring stretch; Partner hamstring stretch
notes: Proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation: contract 6 sec, relax, then stretch 20–30 sec.

name: Seated plantar fascia stretch
form_cues: Sit and cross one foot over the other knee.; Pull your toes back toward your shin.; Feel along the arch with the other thumb.
common_mistakes: Pulling the ankle instead of the toes; Rushing it
safety: Great first thing in the morning for plantar fasciitis.

name: Seated single-leg hamstring stretch
form_cues: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot against the inner thigh.; Hinge forward from the hips toward the straight leg's foot.; Keep your chest long rather than curling down.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back; Bouncing
safety: Sit on a cushion if your lower back rounds a lot.

name: Side lunge adductor stretch
form_cues: Stand with feet wide.; Shift into one bent knee, keeping the other leg straight.; Keep both feet flat and chest up.
common_mistakes: Bent knee caving inward; Straight-leg foot rolling onto its edge
safety: Keep the bent knee tracking over the toes.
aliases: Standing groin stretch; Lateral lunge stretch

name: Sleeper stretch
primary_muscles: Posterior rotator cuff; Posterior shoulder capsule
form_cues: Lie on your side with the bottom arm out at 90°, elbow bent.; Use the top hand to press the forearm gently toward the floor.; Roll back slightly to ease pressure on the shoulder.
common_mistakes: Pushing hard into pain; Lying directly on the point of the shoulder
safety: Very gentle pressure only; stop with any sharp front-of-shoulder pain.
notes: Popular with throwers and racquet-sport players.

name: Standing hamstring stretch
form_cues: Put one heel on a low step with the leg straight.; Keep your back flat and hinge forward from the hips.; Point the toes up for more stretch.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back to reach down; Locking the knee hard
safety: Use a lower step if you feel it behind the knee rather than the thigh.
aliases: Heel-on-step hamstring stretch; Elevated hamstring stretch

name: Standing IT band stretch
form_cues: Cross one leg behind the other.; Push the hip of the back leg out to the side.; Reach the same arm overhead and lean away.
common_mistakes: Bending forward; Bending the back knee
safety: Hold a wall for balance.
aliases: Cross-leg side stretch; Standing TFL stretch
notes: The IT band itself barely stretches; this mainly targets the TFL and glute.

name: Standing quad stretch
form_cues: Stand tall and grab one ankle behind you.; Pull the heel toward your glute, knees together.; Tuck your pelvis gently to feel more in the hip.
common_mistakes: Arching the back; Knee flaring out to the side
safety: Hold a wall for balance; don't yank the ankle.

name: Supine figure-four stretch
form_cues: Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the other knee.; Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest.; Gently push the crossed knee away to deepen it.
common_mistakes: Lifting the head and shoulders; Letting the ankle sickle
safety: Flex the crossed foot to protect the knee.
aliases: Lying piriformis stretch; Figure-4 glute stretch

name: Towel internal rotation stretch
form_cues: Hold a towel overhead with one hand and behind your back with the other.; Pull up with the top hand to raise the lower hand.; Keep shoulders relaxed.
common_mistakes: Yanking the towel; Arching the back
safety: Gentle pull only; common in shoulder rehab programmes.
aliases: Behind-back towel stretch; Towel shoulder stretch

name: Upper trap stretch
form_cues: Sit tall and hold the chair with one hand.; Tilt your ear toward the opposite shoulder.; Rest the other hand on your head for light extra pull.
common_mistakes: Pulling hard on the head; Letting the shoulder rise
safety: Use only light hand pressure; stop with tingling in the arm.
aliases: Lateral neck stretch; Side neck stretch

name: Wall calf stretch
form_cues: Put your hands on a wall with one leg back and straight.; Press the back heel down, toes pointing forward.; Lean your hips toward the wall.
common_mistakes: Back heel lifting; Back foot turned out
safety: Ease in gradually if you have Achilles pain.

name: Wrist extensor stretch
form_cues: Hold one arm out straight, palm down.; Gently press the back of the hand toward you.; Keep the elbow straight.
common_mistakes: Bending the elbow; Pushing too hard
safety: Helpful for tennis-elbow type tightness; keep it gentle.

name: Wrist flexor stretch
form_cues: Hold one arm out straight, palm up.; Gently pull the fingers back with the other hand.; Keep the elbow straight.
common_mistakes: Bending the elbow; Forcing it through tingling
safety: Stop with numbness or tingling in the fingers.

name: Banded lat stretch
form_cues: Loop a band around a high anchor and your wrist.; Step back and sit your hips back.; Let the band pull your arm overhead and to the side.
common_mistakes: Shrugging up; Rounding through the lower back
safety: Use a secure anchor; check the band for tears.

name: Stability ball back stretch
form_cues: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward.; Lie back so the ball supports your upper and mid back.; Reach your arms overhead and relax.
common_mistakes: Letting the head drop unsupported; Feet too close together
safety: Keep feet wide for balance; avoid if you get dizzy.
aliases: Ball thoracic extension; Swiss ball back extension stretch

name: Strap adductor stretch
form_cues: Lie on your back with a strap on one foot, leg straight up.; Lower the leg out to the side.; Keep the opposite hip pinned down.
common_mistakes: Rolling the pelvis over; Bending the knee
safety: Lower only as far as your hips stay level.

name: Strap hamstring stretch
form_cues: Lie on your back with a strap around one foot.; Raise the straight leg until you feel a stretch.; Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
common_mistakes: Bending the raised knee a lot; Lifting the hips
safety: Use a towel if you don't have a strap.
aliases: Lying hamstring stretch; Supine hamstring stretch

name: Strap prone quad stretch
form_cues: Lie face down with a strap looped around one ankle.; Pull the heel toward your glute.; Press the hip into the floor.
common_mistakes: Arching the back; Knee drifting outward
safety: Ease the strap in slowly.

name: Bench lat stretch
form_cues: Kneel facing a bench with elbows on the edge.; Bend the elbows so your hands meet behind your head (or hold a dowel).; Sit hips back and let the chest sink.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back; Shrugging
safety: Keep ribs down; stop with shoulder pinching.
aliases: Kneeling bench lat stretch; Elbows-on-bench T-spine stretch
notes: Great prep for overhead squats and presses.

name: 90/90 breathing
form_cues: Lie on your back with feet on a wall, hips and knees at 90°.; Breathe in through the nose into the ribs and belly.; Exhale fully through the mouth and pause.
common_mistakes: Breathing only into the chest; Arching the lower back
safety: Very safe; a good post-workout cool-down to calm the nervous system.

name: Chin tucks
form_cues: Sit or stand tall looking straight ahead.; Slide your chin straight back to make a double chin.; Hold 2–3 seconds and relax.
common_mistakes: Tipping the head down instead of sliding back; Straining the jaw
progressions: Supine chin tuck with head lift
safety: Stop if you get dizziness or arm symptoms.
notes: Good counter to 'tech neck' posture.

name: Eccentric heel drop
form_cues: Stand on a step and rise up on both feet.; Shift onto one foot and lower the heel slowly below the step.; Use both feet to come back up.
common_mistakes: Dropping fast instead of lowering slowly; Bouncing at the bottom
safety: Mild tendon discomfort is common; stop if pain is sharp or worsening.
aliases: Alfredson heel drop; Eccentric calf lowering
notes: Classic Achilles tendinopathy protocol; do with straight and bent knee.

name: Prone press-up
form_cues: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.; Press your chest up, letting the hips and belly stay on the floor.; Relax your lower back and lower slowly.
common_mistakes: Squeezing the glutes and lifting the hips; Going into painful range
safety: Stop if leg pain spreads further down; see a professional for disc issues.
notes: Part of the McKenzie method for some back pain types.

name: Sciatic nerve floss
form_cues: Sit tall at the edge of a chair.; Straighten one knee while you look up.; Bend the knee as you look down; keep it smooth.
common_mistakes: Holding at end range like a stretch; Moving into tingling
safety: Should feel mild; stop if symptoms increase or linger.
aliases: Seated nerve glide; Slump nerve glide
notes: Nerves like movement, not long holds.

name: Short foot exercise
form_cues: Sit or stand with the foot flat.; Draw the ball of the foot toward the heel to lift the arch.; Keep the toes long and relaxed.
common_mistakes: Curling the toes; Rolling the foot outward
safety: Gentle and safe; useful for flat feet and plantar pain.

name: Foam roll calves
form_cues: Sit with the roller under your calves.; Lift your hips and roll from ankle to knee.; Turn the foot in and out to hit each side.
common_mistakes: Rolling over the Achilles hard; Going too fast
safety: Stack one leg on top for more pressure.

name: Foam roll chest
form_cues: Lie face down with the roller at an angle under one side of the chest.; Extend that arm out to the side.; Roll slowly from the breastbone toward the shoulder.
common_mistakes: Rolling over the collarbone; Too much body weight
safety: Light pressure; avoid the front of the shoulder joint.

name: Foam roll glutes
form_cues: Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the other knee.; Lean toward the crossed-leg side.; Roll slowly over the glute.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the lower back; Rolling fast
safety: Stay on the meaty glute area, away from the tailbone.

name: Foam roll hamstrings
form_cues: Sit with the roller under your thighs and hands behind you.; Lift your hips and roll from knee to glute.; Cross one leg over the other for more pressure.
common_mistakes: Rolling behind the knee; Rushing
safety: Avoid the back of the knee.

name: Foam roll IT band
form_cues: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.; Use the top leg and hands to control pressure.; Roll from hip to just above the knee.
common_mistakes: Putting full body weight on it; Rolling over the hip bone
safety: This area is sensitive; reduce pressure with the top foot.
aliases: Lateral thigh roll; IT band roll

name: Foam roll lats
form_cues: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit, arm overhead.; Roll down toward the bottom of the ribs.; Rotate slightly forward and back.
common_mistakes: Rolling over the shoulder joint; Rolling onto the ribs too hard
safety: Keep the head supported on the arm.

name: Foam roll legs and back
form_cues: Roll slowly, about 2–3 cm per second.; Pause 20–30 seconds on tender spots and breathe.; Spend 30–60 seconds on each area.
common_mistakes: Rolling too fast; Rolling directly on joints or the lower back
safety: Avoid bony areas, the lower back and the neck.
notes: General routine; see individual entries for each area.

name: Foam roll quads
form_cues: Lie face down with the roller under your thighs.; Roll from just above the knee to the hip.; Turn slightly in and out to hit inner and outer quads.
common_mistakes: Sagging the hips; Rolling over the kneecap
safety: Keep your core braced to protect the lower back.

name: Foam roll thoracic spine
form_cues: Lie with the roller under your upper back, hands behind your head.; Roll from mid-back to the shoulder blades.; Pause and gently extend over the roller at stiff spots.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the lower back; Flaring ribs and arching from the lower back
safety: Never roll the lumbar spine; support your head.
aliases: Upper back roll; Foam roller thoracic extension

name: Massage ball foot roll
form_cues: Stand or sit with the ball under one foot.; Roll from heel to toes with steady pressure.; Pause on tender spots.
common_mistakes: Standing with full weight straight away; Rolling the heel bone hard
safety: A frozen water bottle works for sore arches.
aliases: Plantar fascia ball roll; Foot ball release

name: Massage ball forearm release
form_cues: Place the ball on a table under your forearm.; Press down with the other hand.; Open and close your fist as you roll.
common_mistakes: Rolling over the elbow joint; Pressing too hard
safety: Good for climbers, lifters with grippy forearms and desk workers.

name: Massage ball glute release
form_cues: Sit or lie with the ball under one glute.; Find a tender spot and let your weight sink in.; Breathe and make small circles.
common_mistakes: Rolling on the sciatic nerve with sharp, shooting pain; Going too hard
safety: Move off any spot that causes numbness or shooting pain.
aliases: Lacrosse ball glute release; Piriformis ball release
notes: Do it against a wall for less pressure.

name: Massage ball pec release
form_cues: Stand facing a wall with the ball under your chest, just inside the shoulder.; Lean in to apply pressure.; Slowly move the arm up and down.
common_mistakes: Pressing on the collarbone or armpit nerves; Too much pressure
safety: Stay on soft tissue; stop with tingling down the arm.

name: Massage ball TFL release
form_cues: Lie face down with the ball just in front of and below the hip bone.; Let your weight sink in.; Bend and straighten the knee slowly.
common_mistakes: Pressing on the hip bone; Lying on it with full weight from the start
safety: Avoid the groin area and front-of-hip nerves.
aliases: Hip flexor ball release; Lacrosse ball TFL

name: Massage ball upper back release
form_cues: Stand against a wall or lie with the ball between spine and shoulder blade.; Lean into the ball at a tender spot.; Cross the arm over your chest to open the area.
common_mistakes: Putting the ball on the spine; Rolling onto the neck
safety: Keep the ball off the spine and the neck.
aliases: Lacrosse ball trap release; Shoulder blade ball release

name: Chair pose
form_cues: Sit hips back as if onto a chair, weight in the heels.; Keep knees behind the toes.; Reach arms up and draw the belly in.
common_mistakes: Arching the low back; Letting knees drift far past the toes
regressions: Wall sit with hands on thighs
safety: Keep the bend shallower if knees hurt.

name: Eagle pose
form_cues: Sit into a slight squat, wrap one thigh over the other.; Cross arms and lift elbows to shoulder height.; Squeeze everything toward the midline.
common_mistakes: Standing knee locked straight; Shoulders hunched up to the ears
regressions: Toes of the top leg on the floor
safety: Skip the leg wrap if you have knee pain.

name: Extended side angle
form_cues: From Warrior II, rest the forearm on the front thigh or hand on a block.; Reach the top arm over your ear in one long line.; Roll the top ribs open toward the ceiling.
common_mistakes: Dumping weight into the forearm; Collapsing the chest toward the floor
safety: Use a block under the hand if the floor feels far away.

name: Goddess pose
form_cues: Take a wide stance, toes turned out.; Bend knees over the toes and sink hips.; Keep the spine tall and arms in cactus.
common_mistakes: Knees caving inward; Tipping the pelvis forward
safety: Keep knees in line with toes to protect them.

name: Half moon pose
form_cues: Balance on one leg with the bottom hand on a block.; Lift the top leg to hip height, foot flexed.; Stack hips and open the chest to the side.
common_mistakes: Standing knee locked; Top hip rolling forward
regressions: Half moon with back to a wall
safety: Practise near a wall until balance is steady.

name: High lunge
form_cues: Stay on the ball of the back foot, back leg strong.; Bend the front knee to about 90 degrees.; Square the hips and reach arms up.
common_mistakes: Back knee sagging; Leaning the torso forward
safety: Shorten the stance for knee comfort.

name: Reverse warrior
form_cues: From Warrior II, slide the back hand down the back leg.; Reach the front arm up and back over your ear.; Keep the front knee bent and steady.
common_mistakes: Straightening the front knee; Leaning all your weight on the back hand
safety: Keep the reach gentle if you have low-back pain.

name: Revolved chair
form_cues: From Chair pose, bring palms together at the chest.; Hook the elbow outside the opposite knee.; Keep knees level and twist from the upper back.
common_mistakes: One knee sliding forward past the other; Rounding the back instead of lengthening
regressions: Chair pose; Twist with hands on thighs
safety: Skip deep twists if pregnant or with a disc injury.

name: Tree pose
form_cues: Press the lifted foot into the inner calf or thigh, never the knee.; Keep the standing hip stacked over the foot.; Fix your gaze on one still point.
common_mistakes: Resting the foot on the side of the knee; Standing hip jutting out to the side
regressions: Tree pose with toes on the floor (kickstand)
progressions: Tree pose with eyes closed; Tree pose with arms overhead
safety: Use a wall for support if balance is unsteady.

name: Warrior I
form_cues: Bend the front knee over the ankle, back foot angled 45 degrees.; Square hips toward the front of the mat.; Reach arms up while dropping shoulders away from ears.
common_mistakes: Front knee drifting past the toes or caving in; Arching the low back to square the hips
regressions: High lunge with back heel lifted
safety: Shorten the stance if hips or knees complain.

name: Warrior II
form_cues: Bend the front knee to track over the middle toes.; Open hips to the long side of the mat.; Reach arms out level and look over the front hand.
common_mistakes: Front knee collapsing inward; Leaning the torso over the front leg
regressions: Shorter stance with less knee bend
safety: Keep the front knee no further forward than the ankle.

name: Dancer pose
form_cues: Hold the inside of one foot behind you.; Kick the foot into the hand as you tip forward.; Reach the free arm forward for balance.
common_mistakes: Letting the lifted knee splay out wide; Collapsing the chest down
regressions: Standing quad stretch at a wall
safety: Use a wall or strap; ease off with low-back pain.

name: Extended hand-to-big-toe pose
form_cues: Hook the big toe with two fingers or use a strap.; Stand tall on a firm standing leg.; Extend the lifted leg forward, then open it to the side.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back to straighten the leg; Hiking the hip of the lifted leg
regressions: Bent lifted knee; Using a strap
safety: Use a strap or bend the knee to avoid straining the hamstring.

name: Garland pose
form_cues: Squat deep with feet a little wider than hips.; Press elbows into the inner knees, palms together.; Lift the chest and keep heels down if you can.
common_mistakes: Heels lifting and weight rolling forward; Rounding the back heavily
regressions: Block under the hips or rolled mat under heels
safety: Sit on a block if knees are sensitive.

name: Legs up the wall
form_cues: Sit sideways to a wall and swing legs up.; Rest your back and head on the floor.; Let arms fall open and breathe slowly.
common_mistakes: Hips too far from the wall with straining hamstrings; Forcing the legs straight
safety: Come down if your feet go numb; check with a doctor if you have glaucoma.

name: Mountain pose
form_cues: Stand with feet hip-width, weight even through both feet.; Lift kneecaps gently and lengthen up through the crown.; Relax shoulders down and breathe slowly.
common_mistakes: Locking knees hard; Leaning weight into the heels
safety: Safe for nearly everyone; widen stance if balance is poor.
notes: Foundation stance for all standing poses; good for posture awareness.

name: Pyramid pose
form_cues: Step one foot back about a leg's length, hips square.; Fold over the front leg with a long spine.; Keep the front knee soft, not locked.
common_mistakes: Hips twisting open; Rounding to get the head lower
safety: Shorten the stance if hamstrings feel sharp, not stretched.

name: Revolved triangle
form_cues: Use a shorter stance with hips squared forward.; Lengthen the spine first, then twist from the ribs.; Place the bottom hand on a block if needed.
common_mistakes: Twisting from the neck instead of the torso; Losing balance by keeping feet on one line
regressions: Revolved hand on block; Pyramid pose
safety: Avoid deep twists if pregnant or with disc issues.

name: Standing forward fold
form_cues: Hinge from the hips with a long spine.; Bend knees as much as you need.; Let the head and neck hang heavy.
common_mistakes: Locking the knees and rounding hard; Holding the breath
regressions: Ragdoll with bent knees; Half forward fold
safety: Rise slowly to avoid dizziness; bend knees if you have back pain.

name: Triangle pose
form_cues: Straighten both legs, front foot pointing forward.; Hinge at the front hip and reach long before tipping down.; Stack shoulders and open the chest to the side.
common_mistakes: Rounding the spine to reach the floor; Hyperextending the front knee
regressions: Hand on a block or shin
safety: Keep a micro-bend in the front knee if you hyperextend.

name: Wide-legged forward fold
form_cues: Step feet wide, toes slightly in.; Hinge from the hips with hands on the floor or blocks.; Lengthen the crown toward the floor.
common_mistakes: Weight sinking into the heels; Rounding only from the upper back
safety: Rise slowly with a flat back to avoid dizziness.

name: Four-limbed staff pose
form_cues: From plank, shift forward onto the toes.; Lower with elbows hugging the ribs.; Stop when upper arms are parallel to the floor.
common_mistakes: Dropping lower than the shoulders; Hips sagging toward the mat
safety: Lower with control and stop above shoulder height to protect shoulders.

name: Bow pose
form_cues: Lie face down and hold the outside of the ankles.; Kick feet into hands to lift chest and thighs.; Keep knees about hip-width.
common_mistakes: Knees splaying wide; Holding the breath
safety: Avoid if pregnant or with acute back pain.

name: Cobra pose
form_cues: Lie face down, hands under the shoulders.; Lift the chest using the back, little weight in the hands.; Keep elbows bent and close to the ribs.
common_mistakes: Pushing to straight arms and crunching the low back; Craning the neck up
safety: Keep the lift low if you feel low-back pinching.

name: Locust pose
form_cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides.; Lift chest, arms and legs together.; Look slightly down to keep the neck long.
common_mistakes: Bending the knees; Throwing the head back
safety: Keep the lift modest with low-back issues.

name: Sphinx pose
form_cues: Lie on your belly with elbows under the shoulders.; Press forearms down and lift the chest.; Relax glutes and let the spine lengthen.
common_mistakes: Sinking between the shoulders; Clenching the glutes hard
regressions: Lie flat with a pillow under the chest
safety: Lower down if you feel pinching in the lower back.

name: Upward-facing dog
form_cues: Press through straight arms, thighs lifted off the mat.; Roll shoulders back and open the chest.; Press the tops of the feet down.
common_mistakes: Shoulders shrugged up to ears; Hanging into the low back
safety: Use cobra instead with low-back or wrist pain.

name: Wheel pose
form_cues: Place hands by the ears, fingers toward the shoulders.; Press up onto the crown, then straighten arms.; Keep feet and knees parallel.
common_mistakes: Elbows and knees splaying out; Pushing up from cold muscles
regressions: Bridge pose; Wheel with blocks at a wall
safety: Warm up well first; avoid with shoulder, wrist or back injuries.

name: Dolphin pose
form_cues: Start on forearms, elbows shoulder-width.; Lift hips up and back into an inverted V.; Press forearms down and push away from the floor.
common_mistakes: Elbows sliding outward; Upper back collapsing
safety: Use a strap above the elbows if they splay.

name: Supported headstand
form_cues: Interlace fingers and cradle the back of the head.; Press forearms down to lift weight off the head.; Walk feet in, then lift legs slowly with control.
common_mistakes: Kicking up with momentum; Dumping weight into the neck
regressions: Dolphin pose; Headstand at a wall
safety: Learn with a teacher; avoid with neck injury, high blood pressure or glaucoma.

name: Bridge pose
form_cues: Lie on your back, feet hip-width near the hips.; Press feet down and lift hips high.; Roll shoulders under and interlace hands below you.
common_mistakes: Knees falling out wide; Turning the head while lifted
safety: Keep the neck still while the hips are up.
notes: Yoga version focuses on chest opening; see Glute bridge for strength reps.

name: Boat pose
form_cues: Balance just behind the sit bones.; Lift shins parallel to the floor, chest proud.; Reach arms forward alongside the knees.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back; Holding the breath
regressions: Half boat with hands behind the thighs
progressions: Full boat with straight legs; Low boat
safety: Keep knees bent if the low back aches.

name: Crow pose
form_cues: Plant hands shoulder-width and bend elbows back.; Rest knees high on the backs of the upper arms.; Shift forward and lift one foot, then the other.
common_mistakes: Looking straight down and tipping over; Not leaning far enough forward
regressions: Feet on a block; One foot lifted
progressions: Side crow; Crane with straight arms
safety: Put a pillow in front of your face while learning; skip with wrist pain.

name: Side crow
form_cues: Squat and twist so both knees face one side.; Plant hands, stack the outer thigh on one arm.; Lean forward and float the feet.
common_mistakes: Twisting too little; Collapsing the shoulders
safety: Skip with wrist injuries; use a cushion in front.

name: Supported shoulder stand
form_cues: Swing legs over, hands supporting the back.; Walk elbows in toward each other.; Stack hips over shoulders, weight on shoulders not neck.
common_mistakes: Turning the head while up; Elbows splaying wide
regressions: Legs up the wall; Half shoulder stand
safety: Avoid with neck injury, high blood pressure or glaucoma; fold blankets under the shoulders.

name: Bound angle pose
form_cues: Sit with soles of the feet together.; Hold the feet and sit tall.; Let knees relax down, no pushing.
common_mistakes: Pressing knees down with the hands; Slumping the lower back
regressions: Sit on a blanket; Blocks under the knees
safety: Support the knees with blocks if groin feels strained.
aliases: Baddha Konasana; Butterfly pose; Cobbler's pose

name: Camel pose
form_cues: Kneel with hips over knees, hands on the low back.; Lift the chest up before leaning back.; Reach for the heels only if the hips stay forward.
common_mistakes: Hips drifting back behind the knees; Dropping the head back early
regressions: Hands on low back; Toes tucked for higher heels
safety: Come up slowly; skip with neck or low-back injuries.

name: Cat-cow
form_cues: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.; Inhale, drop the belly and lift chest.; Exhale, round the spine and tuck the chin.
common_mistakes: Moving only the neck; Rushing instead of matching the breath
safety: Keep the range pain-free; pad the knees if needed.
notes: Moving flow, counted in breath cycles rather than held.

name: Child's pose
primary_muscles: Erector spinae; Latissimus dorsi; Hip extensors
form_cues: Sit hips toward the heels with knees wide or together.; Reach arms forward or rest them by your sides.; Breathe into the back of the ribs.
common_mistakes: Forcing hips down when knees hurt; Holding tension in the shoulders
safety: Place a cushion behind the knees if knee flexion hurts.

name: Corpse pose
form_cues: Lie on your back with legs and arms relaxed apart.; Close your eyes and let the breath be natural.; Release tension from face, jaw and shoulders.
common_mistakes: Rushing out of the pose; Fidgeting instead of settling
safety: Bend the knees or use a pillow if the low back aches.

name: Cow face pose
form_cues: Stack one knee over the other, feet by the hips.; Reach one arm up and one behind, clasp fingers.; Sit evenly on both sit bones.
common_mistakes: One hip lifting off the floor; Arching the back to reach hands
regressions: Strap between hands; Sit on a block
safety: Use a strap; avoid if knee or shoulder pain.

name: Downward dog
form_cues: Press hands wide and lift hips up and back.; Bend knees to keep the spine long.; Let heels sink toward the floor.
common_mistakes: Rounding the upper back; Shoulders crunched up to the ears
regressions: Puppy pose; Downward dog with bent knees
safety: Rest in child's pose if wrists or shoulders hurt.
aliases: Adho Mukha Svanasana; Downward-facing dog; Down dog

name: Fish pose
form_cues: Lie on your back with hands under the hips.; Press forearms down to lift the chest.; Rest the crown lightly or keep the head lifted.
common_mistakes: Putting body weight into the head; Shrugging shoulders
safety: Keep weight off the head if you have neck issues.

name: Happy baby
form_cues: Lie on your back and hold the outer feet.; Stack ankles over knees.; Draw knees toward the armpits, tailbone heavy.
common_mistakes: Tailbone curling off the mat; Tugging with tense shoulders
regressions: Hold the shins or use a strap
safety: Avoid pressure on the belly late in pregnancy.

name: Head-to-knee pose
form_cues: Extend one leg, other foot against the inner thigh.; Turn the chest over the straight leg.; Fold from the hips with a long spine.
common_mistakes: Rounding from the upper back only; Forcing the head to the knee
safety: Pad under the bent knee if it lifts high.

name: Hero pose
form_cues: Kneel with knees together and feet just wider than hips.; Sit between the feet, on a block if needed.; Lengthen the spine with hands on thighs.
common_mistakes: Feet splaying out and twisting the knees; Forcing hips to the floor
safety: Use a block and stop with any knee pain.

name: Lizard pose
form_cues: From low lunge, place both hands inside the front foot.; Lower the back knee or keep it lifted.; Drop to forearms or blocks if hips allow.
common_mistakes: Front knee caving inward; Shoulders collapsing
progressions: Lizard with a back-leg quad stretch
safety: Pad the back knee; ease off with groin pain.

name: Low lunge
form_cues: Lower the back knee to the mat, front knee over ankle.; Sink hips forward and lift the chest.; Reach arms overhead without arching the low back.
common_mistakes: Front knee shooting past the toes; Dumping into the low back
safety: Pad the back knee with a folded mat.

name: Pigeon pose
form_cues: Bring one shin forward across the mat.; Extend the back leg straight behind you.; Keep hips level, then fold forward slowly.
common_mistakes: Hips tipping onto the front-leg side; Twisting the front knee
regressions: Figure-four stretch on the back; Block under the front hip
safety: Switch to the supine figure-four if the front knee hurts.

name: Plough pose
form_cues: From shoulder stand, lower the toes behind the head.; Keep hips stacked over the shoulders.; Keep the neck still and the throat soft.
common_mistakes: Turning the head; Forcing toes to the floor
regressions: Feet on a chair behind you
safety: Avoid with neck injury, glaucoma or high blood pressure.

name: Puppy pose
form_cues: Start on hands and knees, walk hands forward.; Keep hips above the knees.; Melt the chest toward the mat, forehead down.
common_mistakes: Hips sinking back toward the heels; Overarching the low back
safety: Ease off with shoulder impingement.

name: Reclined bound angle
form_cues: Lie back with soles of the feet together.; Let knees fall open, supported if needed.; Rest arms by your sides and breathe slowly.
common_mistakes: Straining to drop the knees; Arching the low back
safety: Support the knees if you feel groin or knee strain.

name: Seated forward fold
form_cues: Sit tall with legs straight, feet flexed.; Hinge forward from the hips, leading with the chest.; Bend knees if the back starts rounding.
common_mistakes: Rounding hard to touch the toes; Bouncing into the stretch
regressions: Sit on a folded blanket; Strap around the feet
safety: Bend the knees if you feel nerve tingling.

name: Seated spinal twist
form_cues: Cross one foot outside the opposite knee.; Lengthen up on the inhale.; Twist on the exhale, hugging the knee.
common_mistakes: Leaning back into the hand; Cranking the neck around
progressions: Bound half lord of the fishes
safety: Twist gently; avoid deep twists if pregnant or with a disc injury.
aliases: Ardha Matsyendrasana; Half lord of the fishes

name: Sun salutation A
form_cues: Link one movement to each breath.; Move through mountain, fold, plank, chaturanga, cobra, down dog.; Step or jump forward and rise back to standing.
common_mistakes: Rushing and losing the breath; Collapsing in the chaturanga
safety: Drop knees in plank and skip chaturanga if shoulders are weak.
aliases: Surya Namaskar A; Sun salutation flow
notes: Classic warm-up; 3–5 rounds is typical.

name: Sun salutation B
form_cues: Begin and end each round in chair pose.; Add Warrior I on each side between vinyasas.; Keep each move on a single breath.
common_mistakes: Rushing through warrior stances; Sagging hips in plank
safety: Modify chaturanga to knees-down if form fades.
notes: More heating than A; 3–5 rounds is typical.

name: Supine spinal twist
form_cues: Lie on your back and draw one knee across the body.; Open the opposite arm out wide.; Let shoulders stay heavy on the mat.
common_mistakes: Lifting the shoulder to get the knee down; Forcing the range
progressions: Twist with the top leg extended
safety: Keep it gentle with back injuries.

name: Supported bridge
form_cues: Lift hips and slide a block under the sacrum.; Rest your weight onto the block.; Relax arms beside you and breathe.
common_mistakes: Block under the low back instead of the sacrum; Gripping the glutes
progressions: Taller block height; One leg extended
safety: Remove the block and lower slowly if the back feels pinched.

name: Pilates ring chest press
form_cues: Hold the ring at chest height, palms on the pads.; Squeeze the ring with soft elbows.; Keep shoulders down away from ears.
common_mistakes: Shrugging; Locking elbows
safety: Use light pressure with shoulder pain.

name: Pilates swan
form_cues: Lie face down, hands by the shoulders.; Lift the chest by lengthening up through the crown.; Lower with control.
common_mistakes: Crunching into the low back; Shrugging shoulders
safety: Keep the lift small with low-back pain.

name: Pilates swimming
form_cues: Lie face down, reach arms and legs long.; Lift opposite arm and leg in quick flutters.; Keep the gaze down and the neck long.
common_mistakes: Lifting the head too high; Bending knees
regressions: Bird dog; Alternating arm-leg lift slowly
safety: Keep the lift small with low-back pain.

name: Single-leg kick
form_cues: Lie prone, propped on forearms, belly lifted.; Kick one heel to the glute twice.; Switch legs, keeping hips on the mat.
common_mistakes: Sinking into the shoulders; Hips lifting
safety: Lie flatter with low-back pain.

name: Leg pull back
form_cues: Sit with hands behind, lift into reverse plank.; Kick one leg up, then lower with control.; Keep hips high throughout.
common_mistakes: Hips sagging; Shoulders shrugging
safety: Point fingers toward the feet; skip with shoulder pain.

name: Pilates ring bridge
form_cues: Ring between the knees, feet hip-width.; Roll up into a bridge one bone at a time.; Squeeze the ring at the top, then roll down.
common_mistakes: Arching the low back at the top; Losing ring tension
safety: Keep the weight off the neck.

name: Pilates ring thigh squeeze
form_cues: Place the ring between the knees or ankles.; Squeeze slowly for 2 seconds.; Release with control without letting it drop.
common_mistakes: Bracing with the neck; Snapping the release
safety: Keep pressure moderate after groin injuries.
aliases: Magic circle inner thigh squeeze; Adductor squeeze

name: Pilates shoulder bridge
form_cues: Lift into a bridge with hands supporting or on the floor.; Extend one leg up to the ceiling.; Lower the leg to knee height and lift, hips level.
common_mistakes: Hips dropping on the working side; Arching the low back
safety: Keep the range small if hamstrings cramp.

name: Side kick
form_cues: Lie on your side, legs slightly forward.; Kick the top leg forward twice, then sweep back.; Keep the torso still.
common_mistakes: Rolling hips back; Swinging with momentum
safety: Prop the head on the hand to keep the neck easy.

name: Side-lying ring leg press
form_cues: Lie on your side with the ring between the ankles.; Press the top leg down into the ring.; Lift back up against the outside pad.
common_mistakes: Rolling the hips back; Rushing
safety: Prop the head to keep the neck easy.

name: Corkscrew
form_cues: Lie on your back, legs together straight up.; Circle both legs to one side, down and around.; Keep shoulders heavy on the mat.
common_mistakes: Big uncontrolled circles; Back arching at the bottom
safety: Keep circles small with low-back pain.

name: Criss-cross
form_cues: Hands behind the head, curl up.; Rotate one armpit toward the opposite knee.; Extend the other leg long and switch.
common_mistakes: Pulling the elbow instead of rotating ribs; Rushing
safety: Keep the neck long and relaxed.

name: Double straight-leg stretch
form_cues: Hands behind the head, legs straight up.; Lower legs only as far as the back stays down.; Exhale and lift legs back up.
common_mistakes: Low back arching off the mat; Pulling on the head
safety: Shorten the range at the first sign of back arching.

name: Double-leg stretch
form_cues: Hug both knees in with head curled up.; Reach arms back and legs forward together.; Circle arms round and hug back in.
common_mistakes: Head dropping back; Low back lifting
safety: Keep legs higher if the low back arches.

name: Leg pull front
form_cues: Start in a straight-arm plank.; Lift one leg and pulse the foot.; Lower and switch without moving the hips.
common_mistakes: Hips sagging; Shoulders sinking
safety: Drop to a plank hold if the wrists hurt.
aliases: Pilates leg pull front; Plank leg lift

name: Open-leg rocker
form_cues: Balance holding ankles, legs straight in a V.; Roll back to the shoulder blades.; Roll up to balance with legs still open.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the neck; Collapsing the chest on the way up
regressions: Rolling like a ball; Balance with bent knees
safety: Avoid with spinal injuries or osteoporosis.

name: Pilates hundred
form_cues: Curl head and shoulders up, legs in tabletop or extended.; Pump straight arms by your sides.; Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5.
common_mistakes: Neck taking the strain; Belly doming out
regressions: Feet down, knees bent; Head down
safety: Keep the head down if the neck strains.
notes: 10 breath cycles of 10 pumps.

name: Pilates roll-up
form_cues: Lie long with arms overhead.; Curl up one vertebra at a time and reach for the toes.; Roll down slowly with control.
common_mistakes: Jerking up with momentum; Feet flying off the mat
safety: Bend knees or use a strap with low-back issues.

name: Pilates rollover
form_cues: Lift straight legs over the head, toes toward the floor.; Flex the feet and roll down one bone at a time.; Lower legs only as far as the back stays down.
common_mistakes: Using momentum to throw legs over; Rolling onto the neck
safety: Avoid with neck problems or osteoporosis.

name: Pilates saw
form_cues: Sit tall, legs wide, arms out.; Twist toward one leg, then reach the little finger past the little toe.; Restack and return to center.
common_mistakes: Hips lifting off the mat; Rounding before twisting
safety: Keep the twist gentle with back issues.

name: Pilates scissors
form_cues: Curl up with both legs straight.; Hold one leg and pulse it toward you twice.; Switch legs in a scissor motion.
common_mistakes: Rolling the head down; Bending knees heavily
safety: Keep the head down if the neck tires.

name: Rolling like a ball
form_cues: Hug the shins and balance behind the sit bones.; Keep a tight C-curve and roll back to the shoulder blades.; Roll up and balance without feet touching.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the neck; Losing the ball shape
safety: Avoid with osteoporosis or spine injuries; never roll onto the neck.

name: Single-leg circles
form_cues: Lie on your back, one leg up to the ceiling.; Draw circles from the hip, keeping pelvis still.; Keep circles small enough for a stable trunk.
common_mistakes: Pelvis rocking side to side; Circles too big
regressions: Bent bottom knee; Bent working knee
safety: Keep circles small if the hip clicks or hurts.

name: Single-leg stretch
form_cues: Curl head and shoulders up, one knee in.; Extend the other leg long and low.; Switch legs smoothly without rocking.
common_mistakes: Low back arching off the mat; Pulling on the knee with the neck
safety: Keep the extended leg higher to protect the low back.

name: Spine twist
form_cues: Sit tall, legs together, arms out.; Twist from the waist, pulsing twice.; Return to center growing taller.
common_mistakes: Hips shifting; Arms leading the twist
safety: Twist gently with back issues.

name: Teaser
form_cues: Lift legs and torso into a V, arms parallel to legs.; Balance on the sit bones with a lifted chest.; Roll down slowly and repeat.
common_mistakes: Hunching the shoulders; Using momentum
safety: Avoid with back injury; build up with single-leg versions.

name: Spine stretch forward
form_cues: Sit tall, legs straight and wider than hips.; Exhale and peel the spine forward like a C.; Restack one vertebra at a time.
common_mistakes: Hinging flat instead of rounding; Collapsing from the waist
regressions: Sit on a cushion; Bent knees
safety: Sit on a raised surface if hamstrings are tight.

name: Pulling straps
form_cues: Lie prone on the long box, holding the straps.; Pull arms down by your sides, lifting the chest.; Return slowly with control.
common_mistakes: Crunching the low back; Shrugging
safety: Use a light spring and lift the chest only slightly.

name: Reformer rowing
form_cues: Sit tall on the carriage holding the straps.; Pull the straps with elbows bent, rolling back.; Sit up and circle arms round.
common_mistakes: Slouching; Yanking with the arms
safety: Use light springs; keep the back long.

name: Feet in straps
form_cues: Lie on the carriage, feet in straps.; Move through frogs, circles and openings.; Keep the pelvis steady.
common_mistakes: Low back arching; Heavy springs
safety: Use light springs and keep range pain-free.

name: Reformer footwork
form_cues: Lie on the carriage with feet on the footbar.; Press out to straight legs without locking.; Return with control, resisting the springs.
common_mistakes: Hyperextending knees; Pelvis rocking
safety: Use lighter springs and avoid locking knees.
notes: Positions: toes, arches, heels, wide V; 2–4 springs typical.

name: Elephant
form_cues: Stand on the carriage, hands on the footbar, hips high.; Push the carriage back with the legs.; Draw it in using the abs.
common_mistakes: Bending knees; Dropping the hips
safety: Keep the range short if hamstrings are tight.

name: Knee stretches
form_cues: Kneel on the carriage, hands on the footbar.; Push the carriage back with a round back.; Draw it in with the abs.
common_mistakes: Using the legs only; Sinking into the shoulders
safety: Pad knees; use 1–2 springs.

name: Long stretch
form_cues: Hold the footbar in a plank, heels on the headrest.; Push the carriage back from the shoulders.; Pull it in keeping a straight line.
common_mistakes: Hips sagging; Shrugging the shoulders
safety: Use 1–2 springs; stop with wrist or shoulder pain.

name: Mermaid
form_cues: Sit sideways on the carriage, hand on the footbar.; Push the carriage out as you side-bend.; Return and reach the other way.
common_mistakes: Shrugging; Twisting
safety: Keep it gentle with shoulder pain.

name: Short spine massage
form_cues: Feet in straps, legs out.; Lift legs over, rolling the spine up.; Roll down slowly one bone at a time.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the neck; Using momentum
safety: Avoid with neck issues or osteoporosis.
